subject: Quick score sweep + tiebreak plan for Jordan Park
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Darya Novik <darya@talentco.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick score sweep + tiebreak plan for Jordan Park

Team —

Thanks for running interviews with Jordan yesterday. We need to close scoring and decide next step by EOD so recruiting can confirm offer window. Two quick asks: 

1) Please upload a filled scorecard to the shared Drive link (attached template) by 11:30am PT. Use the 1–5 rubric and add a one-line justification under "Concerns."
2) If you feel there is a margin case (score spread >1 or open concern), mark "needs-tiebreak" in your notes and be prepared for a 30m sync at 3pm PT.

I attached the scorecard template and added a tentative 3pm calendar slot (will only run if needed). If we can get unanimous >=4/5, we can skip the sync and move to recruiter handoff.

Thanks —
Kimberly
Director, Talent Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Jordan_Park_scorecard-template.pdf

Subject: Re: Quick score sweep + tiebreak plan for Jordan Park

Kimberly —

Uploaded my card to the Drive (link in the thread). Score: 4. Notes: strong system design, borderline on latency awareness for production (asked clarifying Qs). Marked "needs-tiebreak" under concerns because I want to discuss the production trade-offs with Ethan who owns infra interviews.

Agree on the 3pm slot if Ethan and Aditya also have concerns.

—Marissa
Sr. Engineering Manager

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-scorecards

Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick score sweep + tiebreak plan for Jordan Park

Quick note — uploaded my card (score: 3). Main concern: candidate's perf debugging examples were high level; didn't see concrete low-level troubleshooting steps for a production GPU cluster. I'm willing to clarify during a 30m sync. Marked "needs-tiebreak."

If Marissa and I are the only ones with a split, I propose we do a 20m tiebreak at 2:45pm PT instead of 3pm so recruiting can still start verbal offer prep by 4:30pm.

—Ethan
Staff Infra Engineer

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Darya Novik <darya@talentco.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Final: tiebreak at 14:45 PT (20m) + recruiter handoff

Thanks everyone for the quick turn. Plan of record:

- 14:45–15:05 PT (20m): Marissa + Ethan + Aditya (optional) to run the tiebreak; calendar invite attached (calendar-tiebreak.ics).
- If tiebreak resolves in favor of hire (majority >=4), recruiting to proceed with verbal window today. Darya, please keep 4:30pm PT free for a check-in after the call.
- Lauren, please prep a short paragraph for offer rationale (1–2 lines on role fit + comp band) and drop to the Drive folder by 3:30pm.

If anyone changes availability, flag it here ASAP. Appreciate the fast alignment.

Kimberly
Director, Talent Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: calendar-tiebreak.ics
